verdict.rationale: Mixpanel exposes several programmatic APIs (Raw Event Export, Query API, JQL for custom scripted queries, Feature Flags API) that could be invoked headlessly from scripts or CI pipelines, but there is no explicit CLI, no CI/automation-specific documentation, and no evidence of a headless mode of the product itself outside its API surface. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI tool, CI-pipeline examples/integration guides, explicit 'headless mode' documentation, and any community/hands-on confirmation of running Mixpanel in automated pipelines.
